name: github-actions-writer
description: Interactive, safety-first skill for creating, updating, and migrating GitHub Actions workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Create, update, and migrate GitHub Actions workflows
interface.longDescription: Safety-first skill for writing GitHub Actions workflows from scratch, updating existing ones, and migrating from Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI, or Azure Pipelines. Scans existing configs, designs multi-environment pipelines with OIDC and approval gates, generates YAML one file at a time, and validates for correctness and security best practices.
